item.title: DeSmog Backfires Again (fundraising help for ‘skeptic’ organizations?)
item.description: An activist website called Desmog published an article attempting to attack The Heartland Institute. Instead, it exposed just how far our influence now reaches. The article maps Heartland’s growing network across the UK and Europe. What was meant as a smear reads more like a progress report, documenting how our ideas are shaping energy and climate debates far beyond the United States.

item.title: South Korea’s Developing Net Zero Debacle
